C. Request of Mayor Brock that the City Council request that the City Manager return with a resolution for the City to commit and pledge to the 30X30 Initiative – Advancing Women in Policing to increase the representation of women in the Santa Monica Police Department. Prior to returning, staff shall explore implementation of the pledge, including, but not limited to (1) Establishment of annual recruitment and promotion targets; (2) Implementation of enhanced mentorship and training programs; (3) A requirement for bi-yearly progress reports to Council including recruitment, retention, and promotion metrics; and (4) Ensuring policies and facilities continue supporting women officers' success. The City Manager shall also develop specific implementation strategies and metrics for Council review by June 2025. New Item Received. 8/6/2026

New Item Received. 8/6/2026

a. Discretionary Funds as of 11.7.24

E. Request by Mayor Brock that the City Council preemptively approve Mayor Brock’s use of budgeted travel funds for each to attend the National League of Cities (NLC) City Summit in Tampa Bay, Florida, scheduled for November 13-16, 2024. Resolution Number 11314 (attached) sets forth Council guidelines for travel fund usage. Section I, “Council Travel and Expense,” Sub-section A, authorizes Councilmembers to attend events hosted by organizations in which the City holds membership, including the NLC. It further specifies that any post-election travel by outgoing Councilmembers must be approved by a simple majority at a duly noticed Council meeting. Given that the City has not received certified election results prior to the November 11th Council meeting, it is unclear whether Mayor Brock’s status qualifies him as “outgoing” for the dates of the NLC City Summit. Preemptive approval of Mayor Brock’s travel ensures adherence to Council travel policy without uncertainty. New Item Received. 8/6/2026

  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.

  Florida, scheduled for November 13-16, 2024. Resolution Number
  11314 (attached) sets forth Council guidelines for travel fund usage.
  Section I, “Council Travel and Expense,” Sub-section A, authorizes
  Councilmembers to attend events hosted by organizations in which the
  City holds membership, including the NLC. It further specifies that any
  post-election travel by outgoing Councilmembers must be approved by

  approval of Mayor Brock’s travel ensures adherence to Council travel
  policy without uncertainty, was approved.
